title: SREV-033 file key exists wire

validation_invariants.description: All contracts listed in the contracts metadata must hold before any data is trusted past the validation boundary

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate proves contracts hold under normal and malformed inputs

contracts: KeyPath_len is a byte count, not a WCHAR count
KeyPath_len must be nonzero and <= PIPE_MAX_DATA_LEN
KeyPath_len must be aligned to sizeof(WCHAR)
KeyPath_len bytes must fit inside MSG_HEADER.length from FIELD_OFFSET(FILE_CHECK_KEY_EXISTS_REQ, KeyPath)
KeyPath[KeyPath_len / sizeof(WCHAR) - 1] must be NUL before CheckBoxKeyPath or RtlInitUnicodeString
RtlInitUnicodeString receives only a bounded NUL-terminated WCHAR string
